prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, layout] Grid Layout Pet Selector: Switch the friend selection screen to a clean grid layout showcasing pet traits and desktop behaviors side-by-side. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% and takes an 89s median time; a side-by-side grid makes comparing options faster.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Diagnostics Waiting Checklist: Add a real-time system loading checklist to the waiting screen so users know their desktop engine is launching properly. (why: 3 support emails reported the pet not showing on desktop or app not opening, while home step mean wait time is 2336s.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Recovery Hint: Add an explicit safety hint below sign-in options reminding users how to recover existing pet data. (why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account confusion the top support ticket theme.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Time Expectation Copy: Update the choose path headline and body to reassure users that path choice takes under 10 seconds and can be changed later. (why: Choose path has an 8s median but 514s mean duration, indicating users stall when making a permanent choice.)
